propositions: Every attested gate resolution materializes the entire ~620 MiB ticket tree fresh as tickets-<sha> without hardlinking or delta against prior entries, producing 10^5x write amplification on a cache key with zero reuse.

The tickets cache key advances every ~26 seconds but the dest.is_dir() cache-hit branch is effectively never taken, making the structure an append-only log of full copies rather than a bounded reclaimable cache as ADR 0005 describes.

Concurrent agents running gates multiply the per-resolution disk cost directly, creating sustained single-digit GiB per round of fresh file writes and contributing to machine-wide saturation via CPU and I/O contention.

The fix uses hardlinking and delta materialization via git checkout-index on differing paths against the newest prior tickets-<sha> entry, preserving attestation integrity while eliminating write amplification.

Janitor byte accounting must distinguish entry_size (reporting), exclusive_size (inode-deduped increment for populate/evict), and distinct_bytes (ground truth), as st_size//nlink conflates reporting with reclamation and leaves the free-space watermark short of its target.
